'''2007 Illinois State Championship Ben Scott LS A New Secret Base''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Ben Scott]] at [[2007 Illinois State Championship]].

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|A New Secret Base|TA-L-anewsecretbase.gif}}
* '''Deck name:''' Light Side
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS13]]
